reading_log.notes: Fresh title/authors/affiliations, motivations and all introductory claims, initial related work and link/reconnection factorization.

claims.statement: Learn link selection and conditional FiLM reconnection, default three equivalence representatives rather than all seven outputs.
State includes current and best tours; reward is improvement to best-so-far and does not enforce monotone current moves.
Two independent current/best encoders combine K8 inverse-distance sparse GCN and biLSTM; d128 and three layers.
2000-step gaps .00/.08/.74% with32/48/80minutes per10000; atTSP200 size100 transfer is worse than L2OPT.
Table3 runtimes cover2000 instances; FiLM and K ablations are not uniformly quality improvements.
TSP-specific size-trained policy improves a random complete tour; specialist improvement.
